families.semantic_promise: Frame one major argument with an anchored proof or identity signal.
grid_rules: 14 to 18 mm outer margin
headline spans narrative and anchor only when anchor remains visible
accessibility_constraints: body text at least 9.5 pt
anchor cannot reduce narrative reading order
known_failures: undivided prose exceeds narrative line capacity
weak or missing anchor makes the composition visually unbalanced

variants.semantic_delta: proof stays secondary to the argument

variants.geometry_delta: upper photo field with lower narrative

families.semantic_promise: Turn repeated reader objections into fast-entry belief and rebuttal units.
grid_rules: equal entry treatment for repeated beliefs
rebuttal remains adjacent to its objection
accessibility_constraints: objection and rebuttal reading order must be explicit
card contrast must pass body-text threshold
known_failures: more than eight units become visually undifferentiated
long rebuttals overflow equal-height cards

variants.geometry_delta: single stacked column with large numerals

families.semantic_promise: Present one client transformation with inseparable identity and outcome proof.

regions.semantic_purpose: client identity, quote, and result evidence

grid_rules: asymmetric narrative and evidence split
all three cases in one report use the same rail side
accessibility_constraints: identity proof requires useful alt text
quote attribution stays with quote
known_failures: missing identity evidence makes the case structurally incomplete
too many large metrics collapse the evidence rail

variants.geometry_delta: two-thirds story with right evidence rail
left evidence rail with right narrative

variants.semantic_delta: a sparse case reads as one narrative column
variants.geometry_delta: no rail; evidence runs as a full-width band beneath the story

families.semantic_promise: Explain why evidence generalizes through one dominant explanatory mechanism.
grid_rules: one visual mechanism owns the explanatory field
visual labels remain adjacent to their marks
accessibility_constraints: diagram meaning must survive text extraction
color cannot be the only comparison signal
known_failures: two competing diagrams destroy hierarchy
diagram without source evidence becomes decoration

variants.geometry_delta: top principle with full-width lower comparison

families.semantic_promise: Make a three-to-six-stage delivery mechanism understandable as one ordered path.
grid_rules: ordered stages share one baseline
A3 gutter does not split a stage label from its outcome
accessibility_constraints: stage order is encoded in DOM order
arrows are redundant with step numbers
known_failures: more than six stages become an unreadable process map
A4 variant fails when every step contains long prose

variants.semantic_delta: the complete journey reads at once

families.semantic_promise: Consolidate the report thesis and cost of inaction without introducing new evidence.

regions.semantic_purpose: remembered comparison or cost of inaction

grid_rules: payoff remains visually distinct from synthesis prose
no new claim appears after the synthesis begins
accessibility_constraints: cost comparison includes text labels
reading order remains thesis before payoff
known_failures: new evidence on the summary breaks source coverage
oversized payoff crowds out the synthesis

variants.semantic_delta: one remembered proof anchors the close

families.semantic_promise: Remove final decision friction through explicit objection and response pairs.
grid_rules: each response remains attached to its objection
repeated units preserve equal entry hierarchy
accessibility_constraints: question and answer semantics are explicit
numbering does not replace text labels
known_failures: more than eight objections produce low-information repetition
long responses exceed equal-card capacity

families.semantic_promise: Show what working together means as an ordered set of commitments and outcomes.
grid_rules: stage order remains continuous
commitment rail cannot interrupt the pathway
accessibility_constraints: stage order is explicit without arrows
outcomes are not encoded by color alone
known_failures: more than six stages create unreadable compression
process labels without outcomes feel procedural rather than valuable

variants.geometry_delta: one connected path with outcome rail

families.semantic_promise: Make a real trust bundle legible as cumulative proof without fabricating authority.
grid_rules: proof units share a visible grouping system
source attribution remains attached to each proof unit
accessibility_constraints: review screenshots require transcribed alt text
logos do not replace named organization text
known_failures: generic marks cannot substitute for client logos
review screenshots without source provenance are unusable

variants.semantic_delta: breadth of known clients is primary
few proofs read as a vertical stack, not a grid
variants.geometry_delta: single column of large proof cards, header inline

families.semantic_promise: Close on one clear action with the lightest information load in the report.
grid_rules: one action dominates the face
brand breather variant contains no competing CTA
accessibility_constraints: URL is present as text
QR never becomes the only action path
known_failures: multiple calls to action destroy the close
dense explanatory copy violates CTA capacity

variants.semantic_delta: human or industry context supports action
variants.geometry_delta: full-bleed image with protected action field

variants.semantic_delta: the close is one sentence and one action
variants.geometry_delta: centred statement over a full-bleed ground, identity as a footer rule
